blocking_findings.detail: Repository contains the NQ28 DOC and two QD03 PDF source files, but no legacy app/runtime area files for areas 002-095. Without those files, ID preservation, runtime-contract comparison, and exact round-trip validation cannot be performed safely.

The branch contains an area-001 packed runtime artifact and adapter, but no committed generator that can reproduce area-001 or generate subsequent areas from the legal sources. The existing extract_nq28.py only handles the failed outer-DOC table experiment.

area-001.pack.js expands exactly to a legacy structure according to its audit, but the repository does not contain the corresponding uncompressed legacy source or a reproducible build script, so the provenance cannot be independently revalidated before scaling.

safety_decision: Do not generate areas 002-095 by inference or renumbering. This would risk changing saved-record IDs, legal mappings, search behavior, and the runtime field contract.
required_to_resume: Commit or otherwise make available the current app data/runtime area files used by the existing search layer, including area 001 and areas 002-095.
Commit the reproducible area pack/build script used to produce area-001.pack.js, or rebuild it from source with documented deterministic rules.
Provide the current NQ28-QD03 mapping source or the exact legacy fields used for qdTt, relation, factors, conditions, and surface.
